📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-02-tables-fields-fieldtablenameref-null-linked-fields`
This is occurrence #16 (degraded-cycle catch-up, 5.8d gap). Fired 2026-09-21 22:12 UTC.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `unmapped` (no ownership.md row for tables-fields)
Playbook: ArgumentNullException on account-specific linked fields with null FieldTableNameRef; chronic, account-specific.

Source alerts: n/a — degraded cycle (DD monitor 299251404, alert-no-code-next-gen)

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/299251404
  • DD metric: error rate peaked 5.45% (>5% threshold), sum:trace.aspnet_core.request.errors{service:tables-fields,env:prod}
  • This-window concentration: ES `"FieldTableNameRef Is Null" AND fields.dd_service.keyword:tables-fields` — 91 hits (27 exact signature, 18 GetAllFields Failed, 18 GetColumnForAllFields failed)
  • Full investigation: docs/investigations/2026-09-21-206aafaf44a6c883.md
